title: Seagrove Beach "Fore Seasons" 392 Wood Beach Drive
h1: Seagrove Beach "Fore Seasons" 392 Wood Beach Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach- Short bike ride to Seaside- Private pool *Pool heating is available for this property from Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day.- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Tucked into the coveted Sugarwood community, Fore Seasons is a beautiful 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home that sleeps up to 16 guests. Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach and a quick bike ride from Seaside, enjoy cruising the Timpoochee Trail, strolling the sugar-white sand beaches, and discovering the laid-back luxury and natural beauty that has enchanted generations of vacationers. Guests will love curling up with a beach read on the expansive wraparound sun porch or starting the morning with a refreshing swim in the private pool.Bright white decor and pale wood floors bring a coastal flair to this 2-story home’s Southern-inspired design. Dual plush couches and matching armchairs offer plenty of seating for gathering around the 65” Smart TV after a day of beachside fun. The concrete dining room table sits beneath a coffered ceiling, creating a luxe atmosphere for 6 to dine. Cooking aficionados will adore the Thermador appliances and gorgeous countertops in the spacious kitchen—with an island that seats 5 and a cozy sitting area to the side for easy entertaining. The adjacent pantry room has 2 beverage coolers and connects to the laundry room. Grab a pitcher of sangria and savor the gentle breeze on the screened porch, which includes a 4-person table and a sitting area with a TV. Outside, 6 poolside loungers beckon guests to bask under the golden sun, and a table for 8 encourages alfresco dining. When it’s time to turn in for the night, there is a primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a guest bedroom with a king bed.Upstairs, 2 guest bedrooms each have a king bed, alongside a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and a private bathroom.Experience the joy of a Seagrove Beach getaway at Fore Seasons. Leisurely explore with parking for 6 vehicles and 5 complimentary adult bikes. The nearest beach access is Greenwood Street Public Beach Access at the south end of Greenwood Street—a 13-minute walk. Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is a short 4-minute drive for access with parking. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King BedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach and a quick bike ride from Seaside, enjoy cruising the Timpoochee Trail, strolling the sugar-white sand beaches, and discovering the laid-back luxury and natural beauty that has enchanted generations of vacationers. Guests will love curling up with a beach read on the expansive wraparound sun porch or starting the morning with a refreshing swim in the private pool. Bright white decor and pale wood floors bring a coastal flair to this 2-story home’s Southern-inspired design.
